name: buridan-autocomplete-repro
description: jsdom + react-dom + esbuild harness that mounts the real BuridanAutocompleteRoot source extracted from components/ui/autocomplete.py (with its JSX transpiled by esbuild) and drives the Escape->Enter / Escape->Arrow->Enter sequences that expose the close-animation keydown bug. react and react-dom are pinned to the same major shipped by the Reflex web app (see reflex.lock/package.json); jsdom is pinned independently to the version below; esbuild is the transpile-only JSX->React.createElement pipeline (no bundler required).
